validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="go" target="left right"/>
    <transition event="back" target="left"/>
  </state>
  <final id="left"/>
  <final id="right"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition targets `left` and `right` cannot be active at the same time

secondary.message: only one child of this state can be active

notes: both targets lie in different children of the <scxml> root, which is not a <parallel> and can have only one active child; a multi-target set must form a legal state configuration
removing `right` (keeping `left`) would leave `right` unreachable: no other transition, `initial`, or history default enters it
diagnostics.help: keep only one of these targets, or place them in different regions of a common `<parallel>` ancestor
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
